snippet.title: Diablo IV | Season of Divine Intervention | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
“Darkness gathers. But fear not, Wanderer. A new day is coming. And you will be the dawn.” - Hadriel

Beat back the Lesser Evils with the power of the Divine Gifts. Partake in evolved monster combat, a reworked item journey, and more in the Season of Divine Intervention.

Coming December 11. Prepare yourself: https://blizz.ly/3KybnQ4
